thread:
maria_cs: Hey team — prepping ACME QBR tomorrow. Need a quick confirm on cost runway and onboarding blockers. TL;DR: renewal flagged if >15% QoQ spend jump. Can we get a 90d forecast + current budget alert status by 11am PT? @trent_rev
trent_rev: On it. Pulling committed vs actual now. Will have token-burn forecast and a scenario for cache vs no-cache by 10:30.
ashley_finance: I pulled last 30d billing — heavy embedding usage from their search svc. Can share a breakdown, but short: embeddings are the cost driver.
jai_sol: Onboarding update — prod rollout is at 66%. Waiting on customer TLS client certs for the caching proxy; until certs are in, they can't use local KV/prefix caching which explains spikes.
maria_cs: Can we quantify the token impact if certs are delayed vs if caching is enabled? Need numbers for the QBR slide.
trent_rev: Quick back-of-envelope numbers — will refine but here's a starting projection:
```json
{
  "current_30d": "1,200,000 tokens",
  "forecast_90d_no_cache": "3,660,000 tokens (+22%)",
  "forecast_90d_with_cache": "3,120,000 tokens (+6%)",
  "monthly_run_rate": "1,200,000 tokens"
}
```
ashley_finance: If the no-cache path holds they cross their 90d budget cap (~3.5M tokens) — recommend we set an early budget alert at 2.9M and loop in AE + CS. Also propose suggesting batch/quantization tweaks in the QBR.
maria_cs: Can someone create that alert and add the notification list? Also need a one-liner for the deck about mitigation steps.
jai_sol: ETA for certs from the customer is Wed EOD PT. If delayed, short-term we can flip server-side prefix/KV cache as a mitigation — config flag: `enable_kv_cache: true` (needs a quick restart, low-risk).
deploy-bot: Alert created: `ACME-budget-90d` — threshold=2900000 tokens — notify=[maria_cs,trent_rev,ashley_finance,ben_ae].
ben_ae: Ben (AE) here — noted. I'll escalate certs with their infra lead this morning.
maria_cs: Thanks everyone. I'll add to the QBR deck: 1) forecast numbers, 2) immediate mitigations (cert push + server-side cache + batching/quant suggestions), 3) renewal risk flagged with mitigation plan. Any objections to calling out a "renewal risk: medium" in the risk register?
ashley_finance: :+1: call it out but include the mitigation steps and expected delta if mitigations apply.
trent_rev: I'll attach the forecast assumptions (token-per-call, embed vs gen split, growth rate) to the QBR doc in #qbr-deck by 10:30.
maria_cs: Perfect — I'll finalize slides after your attachments. Thanks team — ping me in-thread if you hit any blockers.
